subject: Post-call: Security & Compliance checklist and evidence request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finovatehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Security & Compliance checklist and evidence request

Sam — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned. We covered Finovate Health's primary concerns (recorded below) and what I said we could provide as part of a standard evaluation for Hosted Redwood API.

Top pain points you mentioned
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence for procurement to move forward (tight timeline for vendor review).
- Audit log retention and exportability requirements for HIPAA-adjacent records.
- DPA / data residency language review by legal (standard redlines expected).
- Pen test evidence for our platform or vendor summaries (must be redacted for vendor IP).
- Clarify feature-level controls: MFA for admins, KMS integration, and key rotation cadence.

What I can deliver this week (attachments referenced):
1) SOC 2 high-level summary + what our auditor will share under NDA (attached: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf).
2) Audit log format + example export (attached: audit-log-config.csv).
3) DPA template for initial review (attached: redwood-dpa-template-v1.docx) — we can route through DocuSign once the legal teams agree.
4) A redacted pen-test evidence stub we can share publicly; full vendor report available under an NDA (attached: redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.pdf).
5) Answers on retention: default hosted retention is 12 months; we can extend to longer windows on Dedicated or via an add-on (I'll confirm options below).

Immediate asks from you
- Please confirm the specific evidence your procurement/legal team requires (SOC 2 full report, SOC 2 bridge letter, completed security questionnaire, redacted pen test, etc.).
- If you can, send the contact in legal/procurement so we can accelerate the DPA review.

Proposed next steps and timeline
- I’ll upload the SOC 2 summary + audit-log sample to the HubSpot deal (link below) by end of day.
- If you confirm NDA/DPA path, we can exchange the SOC 2 Type II report and vendor pen-test (redacted) by EOD Tue 2026-08-10.
- Follow-up technical Q&A with Dylan (security) and Monica (CS) — propose Wed 2026-08-11 for a 30-min slot.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1624-FH (I added an initial checklist)

Thanks again — I’ll wait for your note on what exact documents you need so we can prioritize.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik@redwood.com]

--
Attachment stubs:
- redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (summary; full report available under NDA)
- audit-log-config.csv (sample export schema)
- redwood-dpa-template-v1.docx
- redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.pdf
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finovatehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & Compliance checklist and evidence request

Thanks, Karthik — helpful summary. A couple of quick clarifications so we can align with procurement/legal: 

1) Procurement will request either the SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 bridge letter and completed security questionnaire. The full report is ideal but may require an NDA.
2) For pen-test evidence, we typically accept a redacted executive summary plus a letter from your pen-test vendor confirming scope and date. We can't accept raw exploit details.
3) Audit logs: can you confirm the minimum retention you support for admin/audit logs by default and whether we can get on-demand exports in an automated format (JSON/CSV)?
4) DPA: our legal team will ping you with some redlines; please confirm whether you use DocuSign for execution.

We want to move quickly — target procurement review complete by 2026-08-18. If you can get the SOC 2 materials and the redacted pen-test summary into the HubSpot record by next Monday (2026-08-10), that would be great.

Sam
Senior Security Manager, Finovate Health
sam.taylor@finovatehealth.com

On Wed, Aug 3, 2026 at 3:02 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sam — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned...
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call: Security & Compliance checklist and evidence request (internal)

Internal note on evidence and retention options — tagging for visibility.

Short answers we should provide to Sam: 
- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter under NDA. For new prospects we usually supply the report to procurement under a one-way NDA.
- Pen test: We can provide a vendor-signed executive summary and a redacted findings appendix. Full raw artifacts never shared.
- Audit logs: Hosted default retention for operational + admin audit logs is 12 months. For Dedicated we can configure retention up to 36 months (enterprise add-on). We can also provide export hooks (S3 export or API) in JSON/CSV.
- DPA: Our standard DPA is attached to the HubSpot deal; legal prefers DocuSign for execution. Expect a fast-track SLA for mid-market deals but enterprise redlines will need legal review.

Recommended next actions for us:
1) Prepare SOC 2 NDA and mark the HubSpot record as "evidence pending". (Monica)
2) Pull redacted pen-test exec summary and have security sign-off on redactions. (Dylan)
3) Confirm audit-log export format and include a sample CSV. (Infra)

I'll be available for the Wed 2026-08-11 slot for any technical follow-up.

—Dylan
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finovatehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & Compliance checklist and evidence request

Sam — quick answers inline, and next-step proposal.

> 1) SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter + questionnaire
We can exchange the Type II report under a one-way NDA. I'll drop the NDA + SOC 2 summary into HubSpot today. If procurement prefers a bridge letter, we can provide that as well.

> 2) Pen-test evidence
We will share a redacted executive summary today (attached: redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.pdf). Full vendor report will be shared to legal under NDA. Vendor-letter confirming scope and date can be provided.

> 3) Audit logs retention/export
Default hosted retention: 12 months (admin + audit events). Dedicated/enterprise: configurable up to 36 months as an add-on. Export: yes — we support scheduled S3 exports and API pulls; attached is an example CSV (audit-log-config.csv).

> 4) DPA
We use DocuSign for execution. I’ve attached our DPA template and can start the DocuSign envelope once legal confirms redlines (attached: redwood-dpa-template-v1.docx).

Proposed timeline
- Today (2026-08-05): I upload SOC2 summary, audit-log sample, redacted pen-test stub to the HubSpot deal and share the NDA (if you confirm).
- By Tue 2026-08-10: share SOC2 Type II and vendor pen-test under NDA.
- Wed 2026-08-11: 30-min technical call with Dylan + Monica to walk through specific questions (I’ll propose 09:00 or 14:00 PT — which works for you?).

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1624-FH
DocuSign (DPA envelope to be created after legal redlines): https://docusign.com/envelope/example/9a8b7c

Let me know preferred time for Wed and who in legal should receive the DPA.

Best regards,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & Compliance checklist and evidence request

Karthik — appreciated. Priya (legal) is on copy; she will coordinate DPA redlines. We received the HubSpot upload and saw the SOC2 summary + pen-test stub — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of notes: 

- Our procurement prefers receiving the SOC 2 Type II report directly to legal under the NDA; Priya, I’ll forward the NDA details when Karthik confirms.
- We also need the vendor letter confirming the scope/date of the penetration test. Could Dylan or your security contact provide a short statement for us to attach to the procurement packet?
- For audit-log retention, 12 months is acceptable for now; can you indicate whether logs include admin activity (yes/no) and the export column schema so our engineers can validate ingestion? The CSV looks promising but we may request a tiny sample file for validation.

I’ll aim to have DPA redlines back to you by Friday EOD 2026-08-07. For the technical call on Wed 2026-08-11, 09:00 PT works for us.

Thanks,
Sam
Senior Security Manager, Finovate Health
